title: OB1 + SSW3 Status page does not show G5 transmitter information.
body:
When using the new OB1 collector and in conjunction with a Sony Smartwatch 3, the status page in xdrip+ does not show any transmitter info. There are no battery stats, no firmware version, no temperature, etc. Shutting OB1 off restores this information. I am using xdrip+ 2017.11.13. 
![24254691_499501523769101_2150739023329392956_o](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15910886/33569094-8f0742aa-d8f6-11e7-921b-0a2a3ab768b7.jpg)

comments.body: As a workaround, if you go to the G5 status page, then immediately go to the events log, you will see the battery info as the first entry.  OB1 is collecting the data it's just not displaying it.
I can confirm that the workaround does work... ;)
This should now be resolved, please try the latest nightly and let me know. Thanks
@JamOrHam Works like a charm! Thanks so much!
